name: Badges
author: Brett
description: Eight banner badges in one plugin. Claude tests the AI connection on load (axf.llm@1) and carries the Claude Code login on the VPS (amber when it hit a limit or isn't logged in). VPS is a ping: green while the host answers, red when it doesn't, nothing else. axHub is the framework's live check: green only while settings come live from axHub. AmberX shows whether the phone app is connected. The usage meter shows how much of its 5-hour and weekly limits the active Claude account has used, and its drop-down lists every saved account. Disk, CPU and Mem are the server health widgets (disk %, CPU load, memory and swap), coloured by warn and red thresholds set on the Server health page, which a tap opens; the disk passing red raises a console alert that also reaches AmberX. Everything but the Claude test is plain code and costs no tokens. Each badge can be shown or hidden, set to Icons only, given a label, an icon per state (ok, warning, error, off), a side and order on the banner, and a tap action (drop-down, open a screen, run a command, toggle, nothing). Removing the plugin removes only these badges and the Server health page; the banner, badge and clock asset types stay in the framework.

items.title: VPS ping
items.description: Is the VPS pingable: state ok (answers) or error (doesn't), off when no host is known. refresh=1 pings again.

items.title: Server health
items.description: Disk %, CPU load, memory and swap on the VPS, each with its state from the thresholds. refresh=1 reads again.

items.title: Health thresholds
items.description: The warn and red percent for disk, cpu, memory and swap, with the defaults.

items.title: Set a health threshold
items.description: Set one metric's warn and/or red percent (1-100, warn not above red), or reset it to the defaults.

items.title: Claude Code login on the VPS
items.description: The login the Claude badge carries: ok, no-credit (limit hit) or error (not logged in or unreadable).
